_comment: Which page of each publication's PDF is its cover on the publications index. Page 1 is usually the article's own first page, but Science reprints and IOP downloads put a publisher wrapper ahead of it. Chosen by eye from the contact sheet made by scripts/make_thumbnails.py --contact, after --audit flags the candidates. Kept here so every cover can be re-rendered reproducibly if the renderer changes.

basis.note: Every publication in this collection has a Conceptual Investigations Unit author. First pages are reproduced at cover scale under author reuse-on-own-website rights, not under any Creative Commons licence the article may also carry.

_no_derivatives_note: DOIs under a no-derivatives Creative Commons licence, committed here so scripts/rebuild_figures.py does not depend on the gitignored content/survey-cache.json to find them. Covers are unaffected: they rest on author reuse rights, not on the CC licence.
